newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific units' merger effective Jan 1.
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific units' merger effective Jan 1.

text.p: Missouri Pacific Railroad Co (MPRR) on Tuesday said its merger into affiliate Union Pacific Railroad Co will be effective on January 1, 1997.
Both companies are wholly-owned subsidiaries of Union Pacific Corp.

As a result of the merger, Union Pacific Railroad will assume all MPRR obligations. They include the 4-1/4 percent First Mortgage Bonds due 2005; 4-3/4 percent General Income Mortgage Bonds due 2020 and 2030; five percent Income Debentures due 2045; the Texas and Pacific Railway Company five percent First Mortgage Bonds due 2000; the Missouri-Kansas-Texas Railroad Company 5-1/2 percent Subordinated Income Debentures due 2033 and Registered Certificates Representing a Charge on Income.
MPRR also said the terms of its contingent debt would not change following the merger.
